rationale: Sina is building computer vision and robotics systems for e-waste recycling and needs to expand his engineering team; Abdul is a founding engineer with deep expertise in Python, TypeScript, and AI/ML tooling who's passionate about solving hard technical problems. Both are SF-based founders working at the intersection of AI and automation, and Abdul's background in LLM tooling and agent systems could directly complement Tuurny's use of custom LLMs for component recovery.
intro_message: Sina Ghashghaei, meet Abdul Rahim Mirani — Abdul is a founding engineer building AI agents and LLM tooling, and Sina is raising to expand his engineering team at Tuurny (robotics + computer vision for e-waste recycling); your technical stacks and problem-solving focus align well.
